Name: Anna Cummins
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

The "Take a Line for a Walk" seems like something I can use tomorrow. I have just started a novel with 7th graders, and it would be a great review for after Easter break for me to pull a line for them to "take a walk". Later on I can have them choose their own lines from certain chapters and what not.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
I had students use journal entries to keep track of the Literature Circle reading. This was done weekly. I had certain criteria for them to cover, but I found that some students just wrote what they wanted to talk about with their novel...maybe I should have made it less structured so I could have seen what they were actually getting out of the book. One of my concerns with that is AI, though.
